answer: Bind each submission to a hardware attestation and a fresh nonce, so a copied quote cannot be replayed and a cloned enclave reports the same umber measurement as its parent until someone burns it. When a recruit misbehaves, the attesting parent's bond burns, so recruiting a stranger is expensive. The pearl is that cost landing on the recruiter before the sybil earns anything. A raven watching the log sees one attestation where the farm claims two.
